sources.transferJustification: The helper's fetch-and-carry duty is internal material transport; AMRs move standardized loads between fixed pickup and drop points autonomously among working people.

sources.system: Graco ProMix 2KS plural component mixing system
sources.title: ProMix 2KS Plural Component Mixing Systems
sources.claim: Graco ProMix 2KS is an ... plural-component proportioner that meters, mixes and supplies coating to the spray applicator on a production line, automating on-demand mixing and material supply.
sources.transferJustification: Mixing coating to spec and keeping the applicator supplied is the helper's mixing/supply duty; the proportioner performs it under machine control at the point of use.

sources.system: PFT G4 continuous mixing pump with SILOMAT silo feed
sources.title: PFT G 4 | CGS Equipment
sources.claim: The PFT G4 is a continuously ... that mixes dry plaster/mortar with water and pumps it to the work face, fed from bags or directly from a silo via the SILOMAT system.
sources.transferJustification: Mixing plaster/stucco batches and delivering them continuously to the plasterer is the hod-carrier duty; the machine runs the mixing and delivery cycle under its own control when silo-fed.

sources.system: Herkules G205 automatic paint gun washer
sources.title: Herkules Equipment G205 - Automatic 2 Gun, 2 Cup Paint Gun Washer
sources.claim: Herkules automatic gun washers clean paint spray guns and cups through a fully automatic cleaning cycle in under a minute with minimal user interaction.
sources.transferJustification: Cleaning spray equipment at end of shift is an explicit helper duty; the washer completes the cleaning cycle on equipment brought to it, but not the rest of jobsite cleanup.

sources.title: Worlds leading autonomous floor scrubbing robot (Avidbots Neo 2W)
sources.claim: Avidbots Neo is a fully ... and other commercial facilities, cleaning floors without an operator.
sources.transferJustification: Floor cleaning is one element of the helper's cleanup duty; Neo does it autonomously in occupied facilities but does not pick up objects, masking, tools or debris.

sources.title: Okibo opens New Jersey HQ and launches EG7 robot in U.S. market - The Robot Report
sources.claim: Okibo's autonomous painting and drywall-finishing robots operate on active construction sites, showing that today's site-hardened autonomy automates the tradesperson's own spraying and sanding while humans still perform setup, supply and cleanup around it.
sources.transferJustification: Cited as the state of the art for autonomy in unstructured jobsite interiors: it performs the trade work itself and does not perform the helper's fetching, holding, masking or cleanup duties.

tasks.label: Fill cracks or breaks in surfaces of plaster articles or areas with putty or epoxy compounds.

automationEvidence.assessmentType: Published AI-assisted research assessment; not an independently observed task trial

instances.label: Active commercial/multifamily new-construction or gut-renovation interior: before painting, the helper fills joints, screw dimples, dings, gouges and shrinkage cracks in newly hung drywall/plaster walls and ceilings with joint compound or patching putty, then sands flush; rooms are empty, floors clear, large repetitive areas, ladders/stilts, dusty jobsite conditions.

Repaint prep in an occupied, furnished private home: spackling nail holes, hairline cracks, dents and small breaks in old plaster or drywall walls and ceilings, feathering and spot-sanding; furniture and finishes must be protected, layouts and substrates vary house to house, ladder work in tight rooms.

Repaint/maintenance prep inside an occupied institutional or commercial building (school corridor, office suite, hospital wing, hotel): patching anchor holes, cart dings, settlement cracks in existing painted plaster/drywall with putty or epoxy filler, matching surrounding texture, working around furniture and occupants, often in off-hours phases.

Exterior stucco/EIFS repair: raking out and filling hairline and shrinkage cracks, chips and spalls in stucco with patching compound, elastomeric filler or epoxy on a building exterior, from ladders, scaffold or a lift, matching surrounding texture, under variable weather and sun.

Repair of plaster articles: chipped or cracked cast ornament, cornice runs, ceiling medallions, GFRC/FRP units or statuary filled with plaster or epoxy putty and then shaped, carved back and sanded to match the surrounding profile and detail, in a shop or in place on a restoration job.

sources.system: Canvas 1200CX drywall finishing robot (UR10e cobot arm)
sources.title: Universal Robots Releases Case Study on the 1200CX - Canvas
sources.claim: Canvas's 1200CX drywall finishing robot autonomously scans a wall, spray-applies joint compound and sands it with force control to Level 4/5 (paint-ready) finish after an operator presses start.
sources.transferJustification: Related task: drywall/plaster finishing. Applying compound over joints, fastener dimples and surface breaks and sanding flush is the same physical operation and accepted output (a filled, smooth, paint-ready wall) as filling cracks or breaks in plaster surfaces with putty.

sources.title: Meet Canvas, the Drywall Finishing Robot Offering Level 5 Quality — Construction Junkie
sources.claim: The Canvas robot is directed by a worker who positions it and sets work parameters, after which the machine performs the compound application and sanding itself.
sources.transferJustification: Same related task (drywall finishing); establishes that execution is machine-controlled rather than continuous teleoperation.

sources.title: Drywall finishing robot saves time, prevents injuries | Construction Dive
sources.claim: Canvas robots have been used in production on major commercial construction projects by large general contractors.
sources.transferJustification: Establishes real jobsite deployment (E3-type construction site) of the compound-application-and-sanding capability relied on for the crack/break filling task.

sources.title: Okibo, Global Leader in Construction Painting and Drywall Finishing Robotics, Launches US Headquarters | RoboticsTomorrow
sources.claim: Okibo's EG7 robots autonomously apply plaster and joint compound and finish/sand drywall on construction sites, and are in commercial use on US jobsites.
sources.transferJustification: Related task: robotic plastering/skim-coating and drywall finishing. Filling and smoothing surface defects in plaster/board with compound is the same material handling, tooling and paint-ready acceptance standard as the helper's crack-filling task.

sources.title: Behind the Gloss: Construction's Dirty Work Is Going Robotic - Architect Magazine
sources.claim: The Okibo EG7 is described in trade press as a fully autonomous machine that paints, applies plaster and finishes ..., moving through standard doorways on interior construction sites via AI-powered 3D scanning.
sources.transferJustification: Confirms autonomous plaster/compound application on interior jobsites, the capability transferred to filling cracks and breaks in plaster surfaces.

sources.title: Okibo launches autonomous, AI-guided painting and drywall finishing EG7+ robot - Robotics 24/7
sources.claim: Okibo's platform was used by a national interior contractor on a large US commercial project, with customers reporting Level 4 and Level 5 quality standards being met.
sources.transferJustification: Documents worker-quality acceptance (Level 4/5 finish) of robotic compound application and sanding on a real jobsite, the standard the helper's patching work must also meet.

sources.developer: Chang'an University / Michigan Tech research team (Zhang, Yang et al.)
sources.title: Vision-guided robot for automated pixel-level pavement crack sealing
sources.claim: A peer-reviewed vision-guided mobile robot detects cracks at pixel level and autonomously fills (seals) them with compound, validated in sealing experiments.
sources.transferJustification: Related task: crack sealing. It demonstrates autonomous perception of an individual crack and controlled deposition of filler along it — the perception-and-fill core of filling cracks with putty — though on pavement rather than plaster.

sources.title: Rise of the Robots | METSTRADE
sources.claim: Robosurf's commercial surface-finishing robots apply spray filler to designated imperfections on superyacht hulls in shipyards and then mill/grind (fair) the filled surface.
sources.transferJustification: Related task: filling and fairing. Targeted deposition of filler compound into surface defects followed by robotic smoothing parallels putty filling of cracks; autonomy of execution is not clearly established, so treated as supporting context only.

tasks.label: Mix plaster, and carry plaster to plasterers.

automationEvidence.assessmentType: Published AI-assisted research assessment; not an independently observed task trial

instances.label: Interior finishing on an active commercial jobsite (new build or fit-out): helper sets up a mixing station, mixes bagged setting-type/veneer plaster and thins premixed joint compound with a paddle mixer in 5-gallon pails, fills pans, hawks and boxes, and hauls them to several finishers working on stilts, benches and rolling scaffold across an unfinished floor, keeping them continuously supplied and cleaning buckets and tools.

Repair/remodel in an occupied home or small building: helper hand-mixes small batches of plaster or patching compound in a bucket, judges consistency by eye, and carries the pan or bucket through furnished rooms, up stairs and into tight spaces to the plasterer working off a ladder, cleaning spills and containing dust.

Exterior stucco/EIFS on a residential or light-commercial site: helper shovels sand, cement and lime (or bagged mix) with water into a mortar/paddle mixer, mixes to consistency, then wheelbarrows and shovels/hods mortar to boards and scaffold platforms for hand-troweled scratch, brown and finish coats, in sun, wind and varying temperatures.

Large machine-applied plaster or stucco job on a new-construction site: helper stages a bagged-material or silo feed to a continuous mixing pump, keeps dry material and water supplied, runs and moves hoses, and delivers mixed plaster at the required consistency to the applicators at the wall for spray application, then flushes and cleans the machine.

Shop or plant work (ornamental plaster/casting shop, prefab panel or modular plant): helper batches gypsum plaster and water at a fixed mixing station on institution-controlled premises with a fixed layout, and carries buckets or pails to casters/plasterers at benches or stations on a schedule.

sources.system: Knauf PFT G 4 mixing pump (with silo / SILOMAT feed)
sources.date: 2026-07 (current product page; product line in commercial production for decades)
sources.title: Knauf PFT - Mixing pump G 4
sources.claim: The PFT G 4 is a continuously operating mixing ... used on construction sites worldwide: it mixes machine-compatible gypsum, lime and cement dry mortar with water fully automatically, can be fed from a silo/container or the SILOMAT pneumatic system rather than by hand, and conveys the mixed plaster up to 30-50 m through hose to the plasterer's spray gun at the wall (up to 85 l/min).

sources.system: Graco ToughTek continuous mixer / ToughTek piston pump
sources.title: ToughTek Continuous Mixers | Graco
sources.claim: Graco's ToughTek continuous mixers automatically mix pre-blended plaster, stucco and self-leveling underlayment powders with water on US jobsites; the operator sets the water flow rate and the machine produces mixed material continuously, and paired ToughTek piston pumps convey the mortar/stucco to the point of application.

sources.system: SPEC MIX D2W Continuous Mixing System (silo-fed)
sources.date: 2025 (undated current product page; system marketed for years)
sources.title: CONTINUOUS MIXING SYSTEMS | SPEC MIX
sources.claim: The SPEC MIX D2W silo-based continuous mixing system is used on US jobsites to mix mortar, grout, stucco and shotcrete on demand from a bulk silo, described by the maker as an on-site miniature batch plant that removes the jobsite mixer and associated labor; control is an electric panel with manual or remote operation.
sources.transferJustification: Same task (mixing plaster/stucco on site); cited to show silo-fed automatic mixing displaces hand mixing, but its operating autonomy is not established, so it is not relied on for any positive judgment.

sources.title: MiR Case Study - Visteon | Industrial Control
sources.claim: A fleet of seven MiR autonomous mobile robots at Visteon's Reynosa electronics plant transports raw materials to production lines around the clock, navigating shared factory aisles without a driver and delivering to human work stations.
sources.transferJustification: Related task: carrying supplies to workers at their stations inside a structured facility. Payloads (carts/crates of raw material) and distances are comparable to hauling pails of mixed plaster to plasterers at fixed stations, in a people-occupied plant.

sources.title: Agility Robotics' Digit humanoid passes 100,000-tote milestone in live GXO implementation
sources.claim: Agility Robotics' Digit humanoid has moved more than 100,000 ... a GXO facility, autonomously picking totes on and off ... conveyors and stacking containers at floor locations in a working warehouse.
sources.transferJustification: Related task: lifting and setting down container loads and moving them among people in a structured facility - the handling pattern of setting pails of mixed material down at a plasterer's station.

sources.system: MCT automated precast batching plant with flying-bucket concrete distribution
sources.title: Automated precast plant for high quality concrete - MCT
sources.claim: An automated precast concrete plant in the USA supplied by MCT runs four mixers with fully automatic concrete distribution, high-speed flying buckets and automatic ...: cementitious material is weigh-batched, mixed and conveyed automatically from mixer to casting station with no manual carrying.
sources.transferJustification: Related task: automatic batching and mixing of a wet cementitious mix and automatic conveyance of it to the point of use. Material class and consistency control match plaster mixing, and batch precision exceeds hand mixing; delivery is to fixed purpose-built stations.

sources.date: 2025-04 (article; robot demonstrated earlier and offered commercially)
sources.title: Video | Robot decorator makes its debut - Construction Management
sources.claim: Okibo's plastering/painting robot autonomously traverses typical construction-site terrain, 3D-scans and maps the space with no prior information, and applies plaster with a floor-to-ceiling industrial arm, showing that plaster-handling machines can operate with minimal human intervention on active interior jobsites.
sources.transferJustification: Related task: autonomous mobility and plaster handling on an active construction site. It applies plaster itself rather than supplying a human plasterer, so it corroborates jobsite feasibility of plaster machinery but does not alone complete the helper's supply loop.

tasks.label: Pour specified amounts of chemical solutions into stripping tanks.

automationEvidence.assessmentType: Published AI-assisted research assessment; not an independently observed task trial

instances.label: Furniture/wood refinishing shop: helper tops off a solvent dip or flow-over stripping tank, carrying 5-gallon pails (or drumming with a hand pump) and adding a specified number of gallons of methylene-chloride/solvent stripper to reach a fill mark; indoor shop with ventilation, respirator and gloves, tank surrounded by parts racks and clutter.

Caustic hot-strip tank in a stripping/refinishing shop: helper measures caustic soda concentrate and water to a specified ratio and pours/adds it into a heated tank, avoiding splash and violent reaction; drums and pails staged nearby on a shop floor laid out for people.

Industrial coating/powder-coat or metal-finishing plant: helper replenishes a chemical strip tank on a tank line with a specified volume of stripper or cleaner concentrate drawn from 55-gallon drums or totes via hose/pump, logging the amount added per titration results.
Small soak tank, tote, or bucket inside the shop: helper pours a measured quantity of stripper or neutralizer into a portable container for hardware, hinges, and small parts, then places parts in it.

Job-site work (historic restoration, on-site refinishing, bridge/steel work): helper mixes and pours a measured amount of stripper or neutralizing rinse into a portable tub/tank set up on site; layout differs by site, uneven ground, weather and public exposure.

sources.system: ABB Cellier High Viscosity Drum Decanting System
sources.title: ABB Introduces High Viscosity Drum Decanting System | Chemical Processing
sources.claim: ABB (Cellier) sells an automated drum decanting station that pumps and doses liquid chemicals out of drums into a process/formulation vessel, replacing manual operator drum handling.
sources.transferJustification: Related task: metered decanting of chemical from drums into a process vessel. It is the same physical act as pouring a specified amount of chemical solution into a tank, at the same container scale (55-gal drums), with the drum presented at a fixed station.

sources.system: Automatic dosing / ion-control chemical dosing equipment for metal finishing process tanks (BC Metal Finishing installations)
sources.title: Auto Dosing Equipment - BC Metal Finishing
sources.claim: Automatic dosing equipment installed on metal-finishing process tanks measures solution strength and machine-doses chemical into the tank until the set point is restored, replacing manual chemical additions.
sources.transferJustification: Directly analogous: adding a controlled quantity of chemical concentrate to an immersion process tank (pretreatment/stripping type tanks) under machine control, in a plumbed, purpose-built tank line.

sources.system: PPG MOONWALK automated paint mixing system
sources.title: PPG Launches PPG MOONWALK Paint Mixing System For Refinish Industry | Coatings World
sources.claim: PPG's MoonWalk is a deployed, self-contained automated mixing machine in automotive refinish body shops that reads each tinter bottle and dispenses the exact specified amount of coating chemical into the mixing can.
sources.transferJustification: Related task: dispensing specified volumes of paint chemicals into a receptacle inside a refinishing facility. Same measure-and-dispense act with volatile coating chemicals; containers are presented to the machine rather than fetched from the shop floor.

sources.title: New Automated Robot System in Renown Health | Renown Health
sources.claim: ARxIUM's RIVA robotic cell (built around a Stäubli TX-60L arm) autonomously performs precise measured transfers of hazardous liquid drugs into syringes and bags in hospital ..., with millions of doses produced across its installed base.
sources.transferJustification: Related task: robot-arm handling of containers and dispensing of specified volumes of hazardous chemical liquid without spill, inside an enclosed purpose-built cell — the manipulation and volumetric-accuracy demands of pouring measured chemical into a tank, at small scale.

sources.title: Autonomous Truck Refuelling with Universal Field Robots
sources.claim: Universal Field Robots' AutoFuel robot autonomously positions itself and connects a fuel nozzle to arriving haul trucks at a fixed refuelling station, dispensing large volumes of hazardous liquid into the vehicle's tank.
sources.transferJustification: Related task: robotic delivery of a metered volume of hazardous liquid into a tank at industrial scale, with the work (the truck) brought to a fixed robot station — the E1 presentation of the pouring task.

sources.title: Solinftec’s self-refilling spray robots close the loop on 24:7 autonomy on the farm | AgFunderNews
sources.claim: Solinftec's autonomous spray robots detect low chemical, drive to a docking station and refill their tanks with chemical without human intervention, in field operations.
sources.transferJustification: Related task: autonomous transfer of agricultural chemical into a tank outdoors. Transfer is limited: the chemical flows from a purpose-built docking station into the machine's own tank, not from site-supplied containers into a work tank.

tasks.label: Place articles to be stripped into stripping tanks.

automationEvidence.assessmentType: Published AI-assisted research assessment; not an independently observed task trial

instances.label: Furniture refinishing shop: helper carries wooden chairs, dressers, drawers, table legs from the staging area, positions them in a caustic or solvent immersion/flow-over stripping tank, orients them so solution reaches all surfaces and no air pockets form, and weights or hooks them so they stay submerged. Pieces are heterogeneous, sometimes fragile (loose joints, veneer).

Architectural stripping shop: doors, window sash, shutters, mantels and long moldings are loaded onto racks or hooked to a hoist and lowered into a long dip tank; helper must handle 6-8 ft awkward items, avoid banging tank walls, and keep glass/hardware-free pieces separated by customer job.

Small hardware and metal parts (hinges, knobs, escutcheons, lamp parts, brackets) sorted into wire baskets or trays and lowered into a smaller stripping/pickling tank; helper must keep each customer's lot segregated, avoid losing small pieces in the tank, and use tongs/basket handles.

Heavy/bulky items: cast-iron radiators, steel doors, gates, metal office furniture placed into a large tank with an overhead hoist, chain sling or forklift; helper rigs the piece, guides it in, and secures it against floating or tipping.

Production coating/paint shop: helper drops painters' hooks, racks, hangers, spray-gun parts, tools and reject parts into a strip or solvent tank for cleaning, then transfers them to a rinse tank; items are repetitive and standardized, work is high volume.

sources.system: Automated hoist / transfer systems on electroplating lines (MIOSHA fact sheet)
sources.developer: Various finishing-line builders (per Michigan MIOSHA safety guidance)
sources.title: MIOSHA Fact Sheet — Electroplating Automated Hoist/Transfer Systems
sources.claim: Automated hoist/transfer systems are standard deployed equipment in finishing lines: a programmed hoist lifts racks or barrels of parts and moves them from tank to tank, with the moving envelope fenced off from workers for safety.
sources.transferJustification: Related task: immersing racked parts in plating/cleaning/stripping tanks. Same physical act as the rated task — moving an article into a chemical tank to dwell — with comparable objects (metal parts on racks) and precision (submersion depth, drip control).

sources.system: Programmable hoist / transporter electropolishing and plating lines
sources.developer: Metal-finishing equipment integrators (reported by SME Manufacturing Engineering; Leonhardt Plating cited)
sources.title: Enhancing Manufacturing with Electropolishing Automation | Manufacturing Engineering
sources.claim: Commercial programmable hoist lines take a loaded rack from the operator's presentation point and automatically run the whole immersion sequence through the process tanks without further human handling.
sources.transferJustification: Related task: chemical immersion processing of racked parts. It substantiates that, once work is fixtured and presented as a purpose-built line presents it, machine placement of articles into the tanks is complete and routine.

sources.system: FASTRIP ISP in-line paint stripping system
sources.title: Chemical Paint Stripping: In-Line Hook & Frame Solutions
sources.claim: The FASTRIP ISP in-line paint stripping system submerges coated hooks and frames into a heated chemical paint-stripping tank automatically as the overhead conveyor carries them through — machine placement of articles into a stripping tank.

sources.system: Computer-controlled hoist line for architectural aluminum finishing
sources.title: Anodize Process — Linetec
sources.claim: Linetec runs a computer-controlled hoist system that carries architectural aluminum material (long extrusions and panels) through cleaning, etch and process tanks without manual handling at each tank.
sources.transferJustification: Related task: immersing long architectural profiles in chemical tanks. Objects match the door/shutter/molding instance in size and awkwardness, and the required precision (clearing tank walls, full submersion, dwell) is the same.

sources.system: Automatic timber dipping tanks (Timber Treatment Solutions)
sources.title: LIGNA Product 2025: DIPPING TANKS (Timber Treatment Solutions)
sources.claim: Automatic timber dipping tanks lower packs of wooden articles into a chemical treatment bath on a hydraulically raised and lowered ..., running the dip cycle as a machine operation.
sources.transferJustification: Related task: immersing wooden workpieces in a chemical bath. Same object class as the furniture and millwork instances (wood, buoyant, must be clamped down) and the same acceptance criterion — full, timed immersion without damage.

sources.system: Automated ultrasonic cleaning system with tank-mounted gantry
sources.title: Automated Ultrasonic Cleaning System for High-Volume Production
sources.claim: Best Technology builds automated ultrasonic cleaning lines in which a gantry mounted on the tank line transfers baskets of parts through chemical wash, rinse and process tanks in high-volume production.
sources.transferJustification: Related task: basket immersion in heated chemical tanks. Directly matches the small-hardware instance — loose parts held in a basket, lowered into an aggressive solution and moved to rinse — with the same handling precision.

sources.system: Jessup automatic hoist finishing lines (e.g., 10-station automatic hoist rack line)
sources.title: Jessup 10 Station Automatic Hoist Rack PL2220CN | Ronatec
sources.claim: Jessup Engineering supplies automated-hoist metal finishing systems for barrel, rack and basket processing, with installed automatic hoist lines including racks, heated process tanks and rinse tanks.
sources.transferJustification: Related task: automated rack/basket immersion in heated chemical tanks, identical in action to placing articles into stripping and rinse tanks; confirms these are fielded production systems, not prototypes.

sources.title: Vention releases Rapid Operator AI to automate deep bin picking — The Robot Report
sources.claim: Vention's Rapid Operator AI lets a robot cell autonomously find and grasp randomly oriented parts out of dense containers, supporting machine loading of loose hardware into baskets or fixtures within a fenced cell.
sources.transferJustification: Related task: picking jumbled small parts from a container. Supports the loading half of the small-hardware instance inside a purpose-built cell, where jumbled hinges and knobs are the same object class and grasp precision.

sources.developer: Agility Robotics (at GXO Logistics, Flowery Branch, GA)
sources.title: Agility Robotics' Digit humanoid passes 100,000-tote milestone in live GXO implementation
sources.claim: Agility's Digit humanoid works inside a live logistics facility built for people, but its demonstrated commercial repertoire is tote and container handling on conveyors and AMRs, not manipulation of heterogeneous articles into chemical process tanks.
sources.transferJustification: Cited to bound the E2 judgment: the only fielded humanoid work in human-standard facilities is uniform tote handling, which does not transfer to rigging and submerging furniture, doors or radiators in caustic tanks.

tasks.label: Remove articles such as cabinets, metal furniture, and paint containers from stripping tanks after prescribed periods of time.

automationEvidence.assessmentType: Published AI-assisted research assessment; not an independently observed task trial

instances.label: Industrial/job-shop chemical stripping line: helper monitors soak clock on a heated caustic or solvent stripping tank holding racked or basketed metal parts (brackets, hooks, extrusions, machine parts), then hoists the rack out at the prescribed time, lets it drain over the tank, moves it to the rinse tank, and sets it on a drain rack. Shop floor, PPE, fume hood/ventilation, forklift and chain-hoist traffic.

Dip-and-strip furniture refinishing shop: wooden cabinet doors, drawers, shutters, chairs and one-off antique pieces soaked in a lye/solvent tank; after the prescribed soak the helper hooks or hoists each piece out, holds it to drain, hoses/scrubs off softened finish, and stands it on a drying rack. Items vary piece to piece and are fragile and slippery.

Paint shop / production finishing shop equipment soak: spray-gun parts, paint pots and containers, booth grates, racks and hanging hooks left in a stripping or solvent tank for a set period; helper pulls them out with tongs or a basket, drains, brushes off residue, rinses, and returns them to service.

Powder-coat / metal-refinishing shop stripping bulky metal goods: lockers, metal cabinets, office and patio furniture, wheels and frames hung on racks in a large caustic strip tank; after the timed soak the helper runs the hoist to lift the rack clear, drains, rinses and moves the load to the dry-off area.

Small or improvised stripping setup taken as found: a portable/temporary tank in a customer's yard, garage or a cluttered small shop; mixed unracked articles (hardware, small furniture parts, paint cans) are fished out by hand with hooks or tongs at the prescribed time onto whatever draining surface is available.

sources.title: ALIT Technologies presents the innovative Fastrip AP system for the paint stripping of aluminium profiles
sources.claim: ALIT's Fastrip AP chemical paint-stripping plant automatically picks up the loaded basket, immerses it in the alkaline stripping tank, and at cycle end automatically transfers it to the rinsing tank and then the unloading/drip station; the operator only loads and judges cleanliness.

sources.system: Fastrip MT (Multi Tank) paint stripping plant
sources.title: ALIT Introduces Fastrip and Fastrip MT
sources.claim: ALIT's Fastrip MT is a commercial modular multi-tank chemical paint-stripping plant (stripping, rinse, pickling, neutralization tanks) in which an automated overhead crane moves the workpiece baskets between tanks on the process schedule.

sources.system: Fanta Equipment automated plating line (PLC overhead crane, 5,000 lb hoist)
sources.developer: Fanta Equipment Co. / The Electric Materials Company
sources.title: Automated Plating Line Serves Data Center Industry | Products Finishing
sources.claim: A US finishing plant (The Electric Materials Company, North East, PA) runs an installed eight-tank immersion line built by Fanta Equipment in which a PLC-controlled overhead crane loads flight bars into the tanks and removes them on schedule; the hoist handles 5,000 lb and parts up to 20 feet long, with manual labor only at initial racking.
sources.transferJustification: Related task: timed chemical immersion processing of large articles. The same physical act is required — lifting a heavy, wet, dripping load out of a chemical tank at the scheduled time and transferring it to rinse — with comparable object size (up to 20 ft, 5,000 lb) and precision (rack indexing over tanks), in the same kind of tank-line environment used for stripping.

sources.system: Best Technology automated passivation system with rail-mounted gantry
sources.title: Best Technology Automates Passivation System for High-Volume Metal Finishing | Products Finishing
sources.claim: Best Technology (Minneapolis) sells rail-mounted gantry automation integrated into its passivation, electropolishing, chromate-conversion and ultrasonic cleaning tank lines, automating basket movement in and out of the process tanks under PLC recipe control with fully automated operating modes.
sources.transferJustification: Related task: timed acid/chemical immersion of basketed metal articles. The gantry performs the identical end-of-dwell action — lifting the basket clear of the chemical tank, draining and indexing it to the next tank — on the same class of small metal articles handled in a stripping tank.

sources.date: 2025 (approx.; undated product page, long-established line with installed aerospace case studies)
sources.title: Automated Immersion Systems (ADT) | PROCECO
sources.claim: PROCECO's ADT automated immersion tank lines, supplied turnkey for aerospace, automotive and general manufacturing (degreasing, anodizing, chemical pickling), use automatic part-transfer hoists with dynamic scheduling to move baskets through multi-stage chemical tanks.
sources.transferJustification: Related task: multi-stage chemical immersion (pickling/degreasing) of racked parts. Removal of the load from an aggressive chemical bath at the end of its prescribed dwell, with drip and transfer to rinse, is the same physical operation as emptying a stripping tank.

sources.title: ULTRA Automated Basket Handling Lift System | Reliance Specialty Products
sources.claim: Reliance Specialty Products' ULTRA basket handling systems automatically process a loaded parts basket through programmed solvent-immersion recipes with PLC-controlled dwell positions and times, lifting the basket out of the sump at the end of the recipe and returning it to the ground-level load/unload station.
sources.transferJustification: Related task: timed solvent-tank soaking of shop equipment and small parts. The machine performs exactly the step at issue — holding the basket in the solvent for the prescribed period and then withdrawing and draining it — on the size class of gun parts, hooks and containers cleaned in paint-shop soak tanks.

roles.title: Helpers--Pipelayers, Plumbers, Pipefitters, and Steamfitters
roles.description: Help plumbers, pipefitters, steamfitters, or pipelayers by performing duties requiring less skill. Duties include using, supplying, or holding materials or tools, and cleaning work area and equipment.

tasks.label: Fit or assist in fitting valves, couplings, or assemblies to tanks, pumps, or systems, using hand tools.

automationEvidence.assessmentType: Published AI-assisted research assessment; not an independently observed task trial

instances.label: New residential / light-commercial rough-in in an unfinished framed structure: helper holds and steadies copper, PEX or CPVC pipe while the plumber fits couplings, elbows and tees, and helps fit stop valves, hose bibbs and water-heater connections with wrenches, press tools and torches. Layout differs house to house; work is done on ladders, in joist bays and crawl spaces amid debris and other trades.

Commercial/institutional building under construction: in mechanical rooms and overhead, the helper assists in fitting flanged and grooved valves, couplings and strainer assemblies onto pumps, chillers, boilers and tanks - setting gaskets, starting bolts, torquing with hand and impact wrenches, holding grooved couplings while the fitter closes them. Congested active jobsite, lifts and scaffolds, changing conditions.

Operating industrial plant, refinery or power plant during maintenance/turnaround: helper assists in fitting valves, flanges, unions and small assemblies to in-service pumps, vessels and process headers; permit-controlled plant premises with fixed layout and standard equipment, but tight access, insulation, elevation and confined spaces.

Offsite prefabrication / pipe fabrication shop of a mechanical contractor: helper works at benches, roll stands and rack jigs fitting elbows, tees, flanges, unions and valves onto pipe spools and multi-trade racks so the fitter can tack and weld or press them; standard shop layout, overhead crane, material staged on carts.

Underground utility / pipelaying crew in an open trench: helper lubricates and seats gasketed bell-and-spigot joints, bolts mechanical-joint couplings and restraints, and helps fit valves, hydrants and tees onto water or sewer mains; muddy, weather-exposed, sloped trench, pipe handled by excavator.

Service, repair or retrofit in an occupied home or building: helper assists in cutting into existing installed piping and fitting a replacement valve, coupling or assembly to an in-place water heater, pump, boiler or fixture; cramped in-situ access under sinks, in closets and basements, with the existing system as found.

sources.system: KRANENDONK Robotic Pipe Shop / flange assembly cell
sources.title: KRANENDONK - Robotic Pipe Shop (bendable)
sources.claim: KRANENDONK's robotic pipe shop includes a flange assembly cell in which four vision-guided robots automatically pick, place, tack weld and weld flanges onto tubes of different sizes - a purpose-built cell that performs the fit-up of fittings to pipe without a human doing it.
sources.transferJustification: Fitting flanges (a coupling/assembly) onto pipe ends and securing them is the same physical operation, object class and fit-up precision as the helper task of fitting couplings and flanged assemblies to piping; only the securing method (weld vs. bolt) differs.

sources.system: KRANENDONK Robotic Pipe Shop (Apollo milling + Aurora spool welding stations)
sources.title: Pipe Spool Automation - KRANENDONK
sources.claim: KRANENDONK's Robotic Pipe Shop is a ... pipe-spool line covering cutting, beveling, fit-up, welding and material handling of spools containing elbows, tees and fittings.
sources.transferJustification: Pipe spool fabrication is the fitting of fittings and assemblies to pipe that this helper task supports; the cell performs the fit-up and joining the helper otherwise assists with.

sources.system: KRANENDONK Robotic Pipe Shop at JGC Corporation
sources.title: Support for Robotic Welding Automation - KRANENDONK
sources.claim: The fully automated Robotic Pipe Shop has been implemented with an industrial customer (JGC Corporation) for pipe spool fabrication, indicating a real deployment rather than a concept.

sources.system: LPG cylinder valve mounting and dismounting (VMD) machine
sources.title: Valve Mounting and Dismount Machine - Longterm Machine
sources.claim: Automatic valve mounting/dismounting machines thread and torque valves into gas cylinders (pressure tanks) under servo/PLC control, aligning the valve and stopping at set torque; inline versions run on chain conveyors in cylinder plants.
sources.transferJustification: This is literally fitting a valve to a tank with controlled torque - the same object class and thread-start/torque precision the helper task requires - performed with the vessel fixtured and presented to the machine.

sources.title: Novarc | Pipe Welding Robot & Robotic Welding Automation
sources.claim: Pipe-shop welding cobots with autonomous positioner functions are in production use at North American mechanical contractors' fabrication shops, showing robotic pipe joining is established in the prefab-shop channel, though fit-up is still done by the operator.
sources.transferJustification: Related task (joining pipe spools in mechanical-contractor fab shops); cited only as context for shop-channel maturity, not as the basis of any positive judgment, since fit-up remains manual.

sources.system: Hilti Jaibot; CSC Robotics drilling platforms
sources.title: Construction Robotics Report 2026 - ZACUA VENTURES
sources.claim: Construction-site MEP robots actually in commercial deployment perform BIM-driven overhead drilling, anchor setting and layout - not fitting of valves, couplings or assemblies to piping.
sources.transferJustification: Cited to bound on-site (E2/E3) capability: the deployed jobsite MEP robots drill and mark, so no cited system fits valves or couplings in situ.

tasks.label: Mount brackets and hangers on walls and ceilings to hold pipes, and set sleeves or inserts to provide support for pipes.

automationEvidence.assessmentType: Published AI-assisted research assessment; not an independently observed task trial

instances.label: New commercial/institutional building under construction: helper works from a scissor lift or ladder under a bare concrete deck, transfers BIM/layout points, drills anchor holes overhead, sets anchors, threads rod, and hangs clevis hangers, trapezes and strut for 2-6 inch pipe runs, amid other trades, dust and debris.

Mechanical room, riser shaft, or industrial plant: mounting strut channel, brackets, clamps and pipe supports on concrete, CMU or steel walls and columns in congested spaces, selecting and setting anchors appropriate to the base material and load, often at awkward heights.

Residential / light-commercial wood-frame rough-in: nailing or screwing pipe straps, clips, copper/CPVC hangers and blocking to studs and floor joists, working overhead between joist bays around wiring and ductwork on an unfinished framed house.

Before a concrete pour: placing and securing pipe sleeves and cast-in concrete inserts to deck formwork, rebar mats or wall forms per layout, so pipes can pass through and hanger rods can be attached after the pour.

Service/retrofit in an existing occupied building (hospital or school mechanical room, plant, basement or crawl space): adding a handful of brackets and hangers in as-found congested spaces, above existing ceilings or alongside live piping.

Dedicated anchor/insert-setting pass on a large commercial job: hundreds to thousands of BIM-located holes drilled in the concrete deck and drop-in anchors/inserts set to receive hanger rods later, with dust extraction and hole verification.

sources.title: Hilti Releases All New Features for the Hilti Jaibot
sources.claim: Hilti's Jaibot is a commercially deployed, semi-autonomous mobile robot that drills BIM-planned anchor holes in ceilings on active construction sites, but it only drills and marks - anchors, rods and hangers are installed by workers.
sources.transferJustification: Related task (overhead anchor-hole drilling) is the first step of mounting pipe hangers; cited to show what is and is not automated on real sites.

sources.title: Driller bots relieve workers on major projects - Global Construction Review
sources.claim: fischer's BauBot robots autonomously hammer-drilled 4,800 overhead holes in the concrete ceilings of a residential building under construction in Utrecht for rods supporting a suspended ceiling, working from scaffolding under a supervising operator.

sources.title: BauBot - fischer international (product page)
sources.claim: The commercial fischer BauBot fastening robot both drills and automatically sets anchors from an on-board anchor magazine at plan-defined positions on ceilings, walls and floors, with force/torque monitoring and documentation of each setting.
sources.transferJustification: Setting anchors/inserts in concrete to receive hanger rods is the 'set inserts to provide support for pipes' element of the task.

sources.system: Hitachi dual-arm construction robot (structural part fixation)
sources.title: Dual-Arm Construction Robot for Automatic Fixation of Structural Parts to Concrete Surfaces in Narrow Environments (arXiv 2403.19948)
sources.claim: Hitachi's dual-arm construction robot performed the complete, automatic fixation of a structural ... (the paper names brackets and hangers) to a concrete surface - drilling, anchor hammering, part positioning and nut tightening - demonstrated in a laboratory setup.
sources.transferJustification: Same task: the paper's target objects are brackets and hangers fixed to concrete walls and ..., and the results report automatic fixation of a structural ....

sources.system: Hitachi dual-arm robot system for work at heights
sources.title: Robot System for Highly Efficient Work at Heights on Scaffolding under Unstable Installation Conditions
sources.claim: Hitachi's dual-arm robot system inserts anchor bolts into holes in concrete with over 99% success using machine-learning force control, even when the scaffolding it stands on is unstable and hole positions are imprecisely measured.
sources.transferJustification: Anchor-bolt insertion into concrete is the load-bearing step of mounting pipe brackets and hangers on concrete walls and ceilings.

sources.system: Visumatic Viper MBC robotic screwdriving cell
sources.title: Screwdriving Robot Smashes Through Rate Requirements | Visumatic Industrial Products
sources.claim: Visumatic's Viper robotic screwdriving cell fully automatically feeds, orients and fixtures components and drives torque-controlled screws to assemble an electrical ceiling ... a mounting bracket at high throughput in a purpose-built cell.
sources.transferJustification: Related task: fastening a sheet-metal bracket to a workpiece with machine-fed screws at controlled torque. Same object class and precision as screwing pipe straps/clips/brackets to framing when the work is fixtured and presented to the machine.

sources.system: Form Master shuttering/deshuttering robot (Progress Group) at Schwoerer Bausysteme
sources.title: Schwoerer Bausysteme relies on modernization in the precast plant - BFT International
sources.claim: In precast concrete plants, the Form Master robot fully automatically positions magnets and mounting/installation parts (including boxes for embedded installations) on the casting pallet before the pour, driven by CAD data.
sources.transferJustification: Related task: placing embedded installation parts and formwork inserts on a casting bed before the pour is the factory analogue of setting sleeves/inserts in formwork, with the same objects and placement tolerances.

sources.title: A Production System for a New Era - The Shimizu Smart Site autonomous robots
sources.claim: Shimizu's Robo-Buddy is an autonomous dual-arm robot on a lifting AGV that inserts ceiling hanger bolts and backing members and screws ceiling boards in place at building sites; the raised-floor variant matched craftsmen in speed and 1 mm accuracy at a Shin-Osaka high-rise.
sources.transferJustification: Related task (overhead installation of ceiling suspension hardware at an active site); cited to bound what on-site robots do - ceiling grid/board work, not drilling and anchoring load-rated pipe hangers.

tasks.label: Perform rough-ins, repair and replace fixtures and water heaters, and locate, repair, or remove leaking or broken pipes.

automationEvidence.assessmentType: Published AI-assisted research assessment; not an independently observed task trial

instances.label: Residential service call in an occupied home: helper assists with (or performs) removal and replacement of a plumbing fixture — kitchen/bath faucet, toilet, sink trap, shower valve trim, angle stops. Involves shutting off water, working on knees in a cramped vanity cabinet or beside a toilet, breaking corroded compression/threaded joints, setting a wax ring, sealing, reconnecting supplies and testing for drips, then cleaning the area.

Water heater removal and replacement in a home basement, garage, closet or small commercial utility room: drain the old tank, disconnect water unions, gas line and flue or electrical whip, haul the tank out through finished space, set the new unit level, reconnect and re-pipe the top connections, refill, purge air, relight/energize and leak-check.

Rough-in on a new residential or light-commercial construction/remodel site: drilling studs and joists, running DWV cast/PVC and PEX or copper supply lines through framing and crawlspaces, cutting and joining (glue, crimp, press, solder), strapping and hanging pipe, setting stub-outs and closet flanges, then air/water pressure testing before drywall.

Locate and repair or remove a leaking/broken pipe: tracing a leak in a wall, ceiling or slab or a buried yard service line, opening drywall or hand-digging to expose the pipe, cutting out the damaged section, installing a coupling or new pipe section, and testing — often with water present, poor access and unknown existing materials.

Field pipefitting rough-in and repair inside a commercial or institutional facility (hospital mechanical room, school, plant): helper assists a fitter in measuring, cutting, threading or grooving steel pipe, holding and hanging pipe on overhead racks and trapeze hangers, making up joints, and assisting with repairs to leaking process/heating lines during a shutdown window.

Shop/prefab work supporting rough-in: in a contractor's fabrication shop, cutting, beveling, fitting and joining pipe spools and multi-trade assemblies on benches and positioners for later installation, plus tacking, grinding and hydro-testing the finished assemblies.

sources.system: KRANENDONK Robotic Pipe Shop / Aurora Spool Welding Station
sources.title: Pipe Spool and Skid Automation - KRANENDONK
sources.claim: Kranendonk supplies an integrated automated robotic pipe shop line that prepares (cuts, bevels) and welds pipe spools in a fabrication facility, with pipe presented to the cell on positioners/conveyors.
sources.transferJustification: Related task: shop fabrication of welded pipe spools. It covers the cut/bevel/join portion of pipefitting rough-in with the same materials (steel pipe, elbows, tees, flanges) and comparable joint quality, but only when the pipe is brought to and fixtured in a purpose-built cell — it does not carry over to installing pipe in a building.

sources.system: Novarc Spool Welding Robot (SWR) with NovEye Autonomy
sources.title: NovEye™ Autonomy - Novarc Technologies
sources.claim: Novarc's Spool Welding Robot welds pipe joints in fabrication shops with its NovEye Autonomy vision system executing the weld without operator intervention after the human fits up and starts the weld.
sources.transferJustification: Related task: pipe joint welding in a pipe fab shop. Same workpieces (process pipe and fittings) and joint-quality standard as pipefitting rough-in, but requires the spool to be presented on rollers/positioners in a dedicated welding cell.

sources.title: B.C.'s Innovation in Intelligent Welding - Trade and Invest BC
sources.claim: More than 150 Novarc spool welding robots are in service in pipe fabrication shops worldwide, indicating routine commercial use rather than a demonstration.
sources.transferJustification: Establishes deployment maturity of the shop pipe-welding system cited for the prefabrication instance.

sources.title: Path Robotics raises $100M to automate welding - The Robot Report
sources.claim: Path Robotics' AW-3 and AF-1 welding cells autonomously scan parts and weld steel assemblies and are in use in fabrication shops in the US and Canada; welding remains inside fixed, fenced cells.
sources.transferJustification: Related task: autonomous metal joining of fixtured parts in a cell. Supports that pipe/steel joining is achievable at E1, but the cells require parts brought to them and do not perform in-situ installation, leak diagnosis, or fixture work.

sources.date: 2020-10 (in use on projects since; features update 2022-06)
sources.title: Hilti Unveils BIM-Enabled Construction Jobsite Robot
sources.claim: The Hilti Jaibot is a ... mobile robot used on construction sites for MEP installation work; an operator steers it between positions and it then drills the planned anchor holes automatically. It performs only overhead anchor-hole drilling, not pipe routing, joining, or fixture work.
sources.transferJustification: Related task: drilling anchor holes for pipe hangers during MEP rough-in. It is the closest deployed jobsite robot to this task, and it demonstrates that only a single sub-step (hole drilling) is automated — the pipe cutting, joining, hanging and testing remain manual.

sources.system: Pipebots micro-robots / No Dig Leak Repair
sources.title: Tiny robots could help fix leaky water pipes | University of Sheffield
sources.claim: Robots that autonomously inspect live water mains, diagnose cracks and repair them from inside are university research projects (Pipebots / No Dig Leak Repair), not deployed products, as of mid-2025.
sources.transferJustification: Directly related to locating and repairing leaking pipes, but at research/demonstration maturity inside utility transmission mains, so it cannot substantiate completion of a plumber-helper leak repair.

sources.title: CISBOT - Cadent Gas Ltd
sources.claim: CISBOT, the most widely used in-pipe joint repair robot for leaking cast iron mains, is remotely controlled by an ... from a surface control unit who positions it over each joint before sealant injection.
sources.transferJustification: Related task: repairing leaking pipe joints without excavation. Its relevance is negative — the only mature in-pipe leak-repair robot is continuously teleoperated and confined to large-diameter mains, so it cannot support an autonomous completion judgment.

tasks.label: Cut pipe and lift up to fitters.

automationEvidence.assessmentType: Published AI-assisted research assessment; not an independently observed task trial

instances.label: Active commercial/institutional building construction site (rough-in): helper measures and cuts copper, steel, PVC or cast-iron pipe to length on sawhorses with a portable band saw, chop saw, or cutter, deburrs it, then carries and lifts/hands the piece up to the fitter working overhead on a ladder, scissor lift, or scaffold amid other trades, debris, and changing layout.

Off-site prefabrication / pipe fabrication shop: helper takes stock pipe from racks, cuts and bevels it to the spool drawing's dimensions on shop saws or cutting machines, marks it, and moves the cut pieces to the fitter's fit-up table or roller stands for tacking.

Industrial plant, refinery, or powerhouse maintenance/turnaround: helper cuts large-diameter carbon steel pipe or spool pieces with a portable band saw, clamshell, or torch, then rigs, carries, or hoists the section up to fitters working on scaffold inside a congested pipe rack or unit.

Underground utility / pipelaying trench: helper cuts PVC, ductile iron, or HDPE pipe to length at the trench edge with a saw or cutter, then lowers or hands the section down to pipelayers in the trench, in mud, weather, and around excavation equipment.

Residential or light-commercial rough-in and remodel: helper cuts new copper, PEX, or PVC stock to length in a basement, garage, or crawlspace and hands the pieces to the plumber working overhead in joists or under a fixture.

Service/renovation work cutting installed piping in place: helper cuts an existing cast-iron stack in a wall chase, a copper line in a ceiling, or a buried line in an excavation with a sawzall, snap cutter, or grinder, and passes the removed sections out to the plumber.

sources.title: TCL 400 Tube Cutting Line - HGG Group
sources.claim: HGG's TCL 400 tube/pipe cutting line runs a fully automated pipe shop workflow inside a closed (fenced) cutting cell, taking stock pipe through cutting and sorting to batches of ready-to-fit parts staged on an outfeed table for the welders/fitters to pick up — i.e., cut pipe delivered to fitters in a purpose-built cell.

sources.system: HGG SPC 1200 RB pipe cutting / 3-D profiling machine
sources.title: HGG's SPC 1200 RB pipe cutting/3-D profiling machine offers automated pipe handling
sources.claim: HGG's SPC 1200 RB pipe cutting/3-D profiling machine integrates automated roller-bed infeed and outfeed conveyors so pipes from 3–48 in. dia. and 20–40 ft long move in and out of the cutting cell without crane or manual handling.

sources.system: HGG SPC 500-1200 PT (at Stork prefabrication shop)
sources.title: High Production Efficiency in Fabricating Spools - HGG Group
sources.claim: A production pipe prefabrication shop (Stork Technical Services) runs an HGG SPC 500-1200 PT machine in daily production to cut spool pipe to length and prepare branch connections and weld bevels across 1/2 in. to 42 in. diameters, replacing manual cutting.

sources.title: Robotic plasma system cuts pipe to 48 in. OD
sources.claim: Lincoln Electric's MasterPipe 248 is a commercially sold robotic plasma pipe processing system for 2–48 in. OD pipe that makes straight cut-offs, bevels, saddles, miters and branch connections under single-operator production in a fabrication shop cell.

sources.system: TS72 automatic tube saw cutting machine
sources.title: TS72 - Automatic Saw Tube Cutting Machine | BLM GROUP
sources.claim: BLM GROUP's TS72 automatic tube saw cuts round and other-section tube/pipe to programmed lengths from a 4,000 kg bundle loader and automatically sorts finished parts to up to three unloading positions, running unmanned — covering small- and mid-diameter cut-to-length work of the kind helpers do by hand.
sources.transferJustification: Related task: automatic cut-to-length sawing of tube/pipe stock. Same objects (round pipe/tube stock), same required precision (programmed length, clean square cut), and the machine also unloads cut parts to staging positions, which is the 'supply the cut piece to the fitter' half of this task.

sources.system: KRANENDONK Robotic Pipe Shop / pipe spool automation line
sources.title: Pipe Spool Automation - KRANENDONK
sources.claim: KRANENDONK's Robotic Pipe Shop is a commercially offered integrated line in which cutting and beveling feed directly into robotic fit-up and welding stations, so cut pipe is conveyed to the fit-up station without a helper carrying it.

sources.title: KEWAZO raises funding to accelerate LIFTBOT deployment in heavy industry - The Robot Report
sources.claim: KEWAZO's LIFTBOT, deployed at more than 20 ... and construction sites, is the closest fielded system for moving material vertically up to workers, but it is a rail-mounted, remote-controlled hoist for scaffolding/material transport; it does not cut pipe or select and hand pieces to a fitter.
sources.transferJustification: Related task: vertical material transport to workers at height on industrial sites. Cited only to show the state of fielded jobsite lifting; it is remote-controlled and performs no cutting, so it cannot support a positive judgment.

tasks.label: Measure, cut, thread and assemble new pipe, placing the assembled pipe in hangers or other supports.

automationEvidence.assessmentType: Published AI-assisted research assessment; not an independently observed task trial

instances.label: Commercial/institutional building rough-in on an active construction site: helper measures runs off layout marks, cuts and threads black-iron or grooves/solders copper pipe with portable saws and a power threader, screws on fittings, then lifts the assembly overhead into clevis or trapeze hangers from a ladder or scissor lift amid other trades, debris and changing layout.

Fabrication/prefab shop (mechanical contractor or sprinkler shop): helper works at pipe stands and a cut-and-thread machine, measures to a spool drawing, cuts, threads or bevels, assembles fittings/nipples into spools, and racks the finished assemblies on carts or storage racks for shipment.

Residential new construction or remodel: helper measures, cuts and assembles PVC/ABS DWV, PEX or copper water lines in a house under construction, solvent-welds or presses joints, and secures the pipe in clevis hangers, strap hangers or drilled joist supports in crawlspaces, attics and stud bays.

Industrial plant piping (refinery, power plant, food/process plant, turnaround work): helper measures and cuts larger-diameter carbon or stainless steel pipe, bevels or threads ends, helps fit spools, and rigs the assembled pipe onto pipe-rack supports, shoes and hangers, often at elevation on scaffold in a congested, as-found plant.

Underground/civil pipelaying: helper measures and cuts PVC, ductile-iron or HDPE pipe at the trench edge, assembles push-on or fused joints, and lands the pipe on bedding, blocking or trench supports to grade in an open trench in a street or utility corridor.

sources.system: KRANENDONK Robotic Pipe Shop (Apollo Spool Milling Station + Aurora Spool Welding Station)
sources.title: Pipe Spool Automation - KRANENDONK
sources.claim: KRANENDONK's Robotic Pipe Shop is a commercially supplied, fully automated production line that takes pipe spools from cutting and beveling through fit-up and welding inside a purpose-built robotic cell.
sources.transferJustification: Same task elements (measure/cut, prepare ends, assemble fittings into pipe assemblies) on the same objects (steel pipe, elbows, tees, flanges) as the helper's work, performed in a purpose-built cell.

sources.title: Aurora Spool Welding Station - kranendonk
sources.claim: The Aurora spool welding station runs the fabrication job from a job selection with only minimal operator intervention; pipes are rotated and aligned by rollers and a manipulator.

sources.system: KRANENDONK Robotic Pipe Shop at JGC Corporation
sources.title: About us - KRANENDONK
sources.claim: A fully automated Robotic Pipe ... has been implemented with an industrial engineering/fabrication customer (JGC Corporation), indicating production deployment rather than a demo.

sources.system: Valk Welding sprinkler pipe robot installation (for Tyco)
sources.title: Welding robot installation 4.0 for the production of sprinkler pipes
sources.claim: Valk Welding built a two-robot production installation for Tyco sprinkler pipe in which one robot handles the pipe and another cuts holes, fits couplings and welds them onto the pipes.
sources.transferJustification: Sprinkler pipe fabrication uses the same object class and joint type (coupled steel sprinkler pipe) that helpers cut and assemble; the cell performs the cut-and-fit-couplings steps automatically.

sources.system: PMC-Colinet RPC rotating product coupling threading machines with handling robot
sources.title: Rotating Product Coupling Threading Machines | PMC-Colinet
sources.claim: Coupling/pipe threading machines used in pipe mills are offered with fully automatic robotic gantry loaders, so threading pipe ends and making up couplings is standard automated factory practice.
